name: Bale Nacre
seed: Controls warehouse allotments and collections. Loyal to orderly provision; excuses harm as a stock-management problem.
design: Male badger, broad gray muzzle, maroon warehouse coat, square brass inventory tags; no resemblance to Madger beyond species.
history: Stonewake stores worker who survived winter shortages and joined a depot chain seeking regular provision.
desire: To prevent chaotic scarcity by controlling who receives what.
contradiction: Turns a person waiting for medicine into a tolerable inventory discrepancy.
relationships: Veyra values his reliability; Dreg secretly sells him selected freight through a fence; Edda forces him to face recipients.
arc: Falsely calls a deliberate withheld shipment a delay. Later chooses to release it and testify, sacrificing status rather than receiving instant absolution.
story_engine: A depot count with a hidden human cost; an old neighbor recognizes him behind a shuttered counter.
writer_truth: He knows a specific allotment policy causes harm; ignorance is not his defense.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
